rule_outs: Dwelling 8 m from the best section
summary: Bush-facing kerb on Crag Road, but homes line the whole south side.
reasons: Bush opposite, no dwellings across road
Dirt verge beside lane gives room

drivers.seclusion: Eucalypt bush across the road; mapped houses 17 m and 13 m either side of this stretch, own side.
drivers.access_and_room: Dirt verge about lane width beside the road; a few cars are parked on the road edge.
drivers.traffic: Through road with moderate traffic; noise only, van is clear of the lane.
drivers.convention: Cars park here occasionally; no signs, no camping evidence.

flags: Gentle slope: about 3.5% at best section, 5.5% mean overall
Road is a through route up the hill
Dwellings continuous on own side, 7-17 m away elsewhere
sun_shade: Open to afternoon sun from the west; bush canopy across the road shades the morning.
cannot_judge: Whether the verge is hard enough to park on

best_section.where: Crag Road south side, between the two houses just before the bend
